correct_completion: I would have passed the exam.
full_sentence: If I had studied harder, I would have passed the exam.
acceptable_variants: I would have done well on the exam.
I would have got a better grade.

options.text: I will pass the exam tomorrow.
options.why_wrong: This gives a future result, but the stem describes an unreal past situation, so the result must also refer to the past.
The simple past reports a real event; it does not express the unreal result of a condition.

options.text: I would have passed the exam.
I was passing the exam then.
options.why_wrong: The past continuous describes an action in progress and does not give the result of the 'if' condition.

grammar_focus: Third conditional for unreal past situations
explanation: The 'if' clause describes an unreal past situation, so the result clause needs 'would have' plus a past participle. Spanish speakers often use a simple conditional in this position, but English requires 'would have' for an unreal past result.
translation: Si hubiera estudiado más, habría aprobado el examen.
